ta_framework: CM_Ult_MacD_MTF not available for unattended automation (requires user's own TradingView account/layout). Using standard MACD + Bollinger Bands on Weekly and Monthly charts as the fallback, per user instruction, read from public TradingView charts (no login needed).
research_sources_per_stock: ValuePickr forum (search + relevant thread if any)
BSE website (bseindia.com) - company page, corp announcements, shareholding
Screener.in - financials, ratios, peer comparison, concalls/annual report links
TradingView - Weekly & Monthly MACD + Bollinger Bands
Any other credible tool/source found useful (broker reports, Tijori Finance, Trendlyne, etc.)
deliverable_per_stock: One .docx in output_docs_dir named '<StockName>.docx' containing: business overview, source/conviction notes from the sheet, fundamental analysis (growth, margins, ROCE/ROE, balance sheet, valuation), technical read (weekly/monthly MACD+BB posture), ValuePickr/X sentiment summary, BSE corp actions/red flags, bull case, bear case/risks, 10x-in-2-3-years plausibility verdict with reasoning, and explicit 'not personalized financial advice' disclaimer.
final_deliverable: One consolidated ranking .docx ('00_FINAL_RANKING.docx') ranking all researched names by 10x-in-2-3-years plausibility using a stated scoring framework (fundamentals momentum, valuation runway, technical posture, catalyst clarity, red-flag/quality screen, liquidity/float), produced after all batches complete.

scoring_framework_draft.note: To be finalized and applied consistently in the final ranking doc after all batches complete.
dimensions: Fundamental momentum (revenue/PAT/EPS growth trajectory, margin trend, ROCE/ROE)
Valuation runway (current P/E, P/B, EV/EBITDA vs history and sector; room for re-rating without heroic assumptions)
Market cap headroom (must be genuinely micro/small-cap today - a stock already at large-cap size structurally cannot 10x in 2-3 years without an implausible re-rating)
Technical posture (Weekly/Monthly MACD + Bollinger Band trend, momentum, and position within bands)
Catalyst clarity (specific, verifiable near-term triggers: capacity expansion, new contracts, demerger, margin inflection, regulatory approval)
Quality/governance screen (promoter holding trend, red flags, SEBI/regulatory issues, auditor changes, related-party concerns)
Liquidity/float (avoid illiquid SME-platform or thinly-traded names where a real position can't be built/exited)
Conviction/sentiment signal from sources (explicit 'invested' statements, engagement level, but weighted lower than hard fundamentals - forum enthusiasm is not proof)
